scope: Replace clicked selection square with a bordered tentative circle

defaults.tentative: yellow #f4c746 circle with black inner and outer borders
defaults.active: red/coral #ff755f circle with black borders and larger overhead triangle

shared_geometry: Both states use the same ring builder, footprint dimensions, padding, size percentages, thickness bands, tessellation and terrain draping. Independent player appearance controls remain available.
selection_transition: Confirmed combat or ranged aim replaces the yellow circle on the same actor. Different clicked selections retain yellow; a still-selected actor returns to yellow when the active cue clears.
settings: Settings > Banners > Target markers: Active target circle, Tentative target circle, Target triangle
compatibility: Existing square_* saved appearance keys now style the tentative circle; saved choices and logical footprint/collision remain unchanged.
